purpose: Phase-8A resistant-subpopulation model. Represents the tumour-response population as NORMALIZED fractions across sensitive / tolerant / adaptively-resistant / persistently-resistant / unclassified subpopulations. Fractions are relative composition only (never absolute cell counts) and always satisfy the population-fraction invariant. Baseline fractions come from the resistance-context profile; NO fabricated fraction is stated for a NOT_REPORTED context.

invariant.no_silent_renormalization: Biologically invalid input fractions are rejected by validation, not silently renormalized; internally computed enrichment conserves the sum by construction.

coefficient_policy.source: resistance-context baseline fractions (predicted) + deterministic enrichment; general heterogeneity biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: response_modifier scales a subpopulation's contribution to net treatment sensitivity.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No absolute cell counts; relative composition only (NOT_REPORTED quantitatively).
